source: Latest explicit clarification in this Codex chat.
user_clarification: 发布群消息是要的，不一定必须要私聊邀约
correction: The preceding acceptance record incorrectly treated an internal operational-board record alone as completing this fallback recruitment route. The user explicitly requires a real group post; private invitations are optional.

business_policy.scope: 已接受组局委托、没有合适私聊候选人时的群内招募路径。
required_progress: 真实登记待组局并保留客户条件及人数
将对应组局信息通过获授权麻将馆群的看板或组局消息实际发布
business_policy.publish_evidence: 须能回溯实际外发结果及对应消息/看板快照；只有内部Game、发布任务、草稿或发送计划不能冒充已发布。
business_policy.reply: 真实完成上述路径后可以简短承接，不要求对客户汇报后台工具、候选或审批细节。
business_policy.channel_selection: 沿用后端群策略与外发授权，主模型不得绕过通道权限。

original_case_assessment.missing_step: Group recruitment publication. Absence of private invitations is not the missing business requirement.
original_case_assessment.distinction: The original judge complained that the reply did not disclose backend progress. The user-identified missing step is actual group recruitment publication, a separate factual issue.
